task: Add Anthropic effort parameter support to CodeMie UI model settings, replacing/augmenting the deprecated temperature parameter with model-capability-aware field display and a high-cost warning.

key_reasoning.reason: Six-plus components span the validation/utils layer (new effort-constraints module mirroring temperatureConstraints.ts), two independently-maintained forms (AssistantForm, VirtualAssistantForm), the shared appInfoStore/ModelOption model-capability surface, the assistant DTO/transform layer, the read-only sidebar display, and the workflow-editor field registry — multiple subsystems plus new abstractions (a capability flag and a cost-warning UI pattern that doesn't exist today).

The ticket's own comment flags the original acceptance criteria (specific model names, specific effort value list) as stale and asks to disregard them without supplying a replacement; the actual effort value set and qualifying model/provider list cannot be derived from this codebase and must come from a product/spec decision before implementation.

No existing pattern in this repo for model-capability-aware conditional field display or a submit/on-change cost-consumption warning (current cost display is passive, not a warning); the three-plus-one provider-string fragmentation already seen in temperature capping will likely recur for effort/model detection. Partially mitigated by the established name/provider-regex fallback pattern in temperatureConstraints.ts.

Effort logic mirrors temperature across roughly 10-12 files: a new constraints util, two independent form components plus their parent/tab wiring, the DTO/transform layer (assistant.ts, store/utils/assistants.ts), ModelOption/appInfoStore, the read-only sidebar, the workflow-editor field registry, and corresponding unit/integration/schema/registry test updates.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6): change touches core shared utilities (appInfoStore.llmModels / ModelOption capability surface, visualEditorFieldRegistry.ts) consumed by multiple unrelated pages (LLMSelector, ModelsCatalogPage, both assistant forms).
Component Scope red flag 'affects multiple workflows/agents' also applies (assistant-creation form and workflow-editor virtual-assistant form are independently maintained) — already at the cap of 6.
Requirements Clarity bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6): acceptance criteria explicitly flagged stale by a ticket comment with no replacement effort-value list or qualifying-model list supplied.
